name: Thela Stock Manager
changelog: v3.0.0: Super-Easy, Ultra-Fast & Ergonomic Redesign based on cognitive psychology and thumb-zone optimization: (1) Fixed Bottom Action Bar (#sticky-bottom-bar) docking live stock equation preview and 60px RECORD TRANSACTION button for instant <=2s entry with zero scrolling, (2) Distinct color-coded bag identity (data-item) with glowing health indicator dots (Green/Amber/Pulsing Rose) and bold stock numbers, (3) Smart stepper controls (-10, -5, +5, +10) plus quick chips (25, 50, 100, 200, 500) eliminating keyboard popups, (4) Instant party/remark suggestion chips auto-populated from recent transactions, (5) Floating 5-second undo snackbar with 1-tap rollback, (6) 1-tap acoustic UI sound toggle with localStorage persistence adhering to Zero-Music jurisprudence.
